{{Otheruses|Bendu}}
'''Benduday''' was the name for the fifth [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of the [[Galactic Standard Calendar|Galactic Standard]] [[Standard week/Legends|week]] that was used on<ref name="Dining at Dex's">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> The day shared its name with the religious organization [[Order of Dai Bendu]].<ref name="Force Storm 1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]]</ref> A [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] in Coruscant's [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] neighborhood, [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], offered a rotation of [[Soup/Legends|soups]] and specials that changed each [[Local day/Legends|day]]. [[Aqualish]] [[hoi-broth]] was sold for 1.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on Bendudays as the diner's daily soup. The lunch and dinner specials for Benduday were a fried [[Rokarian dirt-fish fillet sandwich]] with a cup of soup for 6.1 credits and a whole [[scrimpi]] in a [[Cream/Legends|cream]]&ndash;based [[glockaw sauce]] for 8.5 credits.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Benduday was created<ref name="Story Behind the Story">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref> for "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
